'''Kalyn Farnmir''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[bounty hunter]] who unsuccessfully tried to pin her crimes on her former partner, [[Cian Shee]].<ref name="FC" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> Farnmir spent [[time]] with Shee in<ref name="AOTC" /> the [[Outlander Club]] in the [[Uscru District]] of the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Coruscant">{{EncyclopediaCite|Coruscant}}</ref> The pair embraced at the club's bar with Farnmir smiling and nodding as Shee departed. Farnmir then leant on the bar and stared at her drink as the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used a [[mind trick]] on<ref name="AOTC" /> the [[slythmonger]] [[Elan Sel'Sabagno]]<ref name="Coruscant" /> beside her. Farnmir was still beside Kenobi when the [[Jedi]] drew his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's second lightsaber|lightsaber]] and used it to [[Dismemberment|cut down]] the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] [[Zam Wesell]], who had been about to attack him. At the bar, Farnmir wore a [[Color|black]], high-collared piece of [[armor]] and black [[glove]]s. She had light skin, gray [[eye]]s, and blonde, close-cropped [[hair]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kalyn Farnmir was portrayed uncredited<ref name="AOTC" /> by actress [[Jack Laurian Pascoe]]<ref name="Actress">{{Twitter|username=ThatPascoeWoman|url=status/1761906903846985753|name=[[Jack Laurian Pascoe]]|date=2024-02-26|quote="That is indeed me! 😊" {{C|In response to: @ThatPascoeWoman if you can, can you confirm whether or not you were this uncredited extra in Attack of the Clones? I'm trying to ID this extra.}}|nobackup=1}}</ref> in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The club scene was filmed on Stage 3 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="365Days">''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Kalyn Farnmir's name was used in the [[Star Wars video games|mobile card game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'',<ref name="FC" /> which initially launched in [[2013]]. Although the launch of ''Force Collection'' predates<ref name="Force Collection release">{{SW|url=news/announcing-star-wars-force-collection|text=Announcing Star Wars: Force Collection|nolive=1}}</ref> the ''Star Wars'' canon reset of [[2014]],<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the game was kept updated to fit with canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|holocronkeeper|status/846807700482666496|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=I'm not gonna go through the trouble of changing them and I don't have any reason to believe currently that anyone would. […] On the off-chance that we DID have a current need to change any of these, we would have for Force Collection.|archivedate=20210505080831}} — [[Leland Chee]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that [[in-universe]] information from ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' conforms with ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].</ref>

[[Kalyn Farnmir/Legends|Kalyn Farnmir's]] name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in a photo caption posted as part of the "[[Image Attack]]" feature on [[StarWars.com]] on [[November 21]], 2002.<ref name="ArtAttack">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2002/11/imageattack20021121.html|series=Image Attack|text=Tough Customer}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm]]'s [[Pablo Hidalgo]] created the name as a [[Tuckerization|tuckerized]] anagram of [[Mary Franklin]],<ref name="WhosWho">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> fan-events coordinator at Lucasfilm.<ref name="Franklin">{{InsiderCite|75|Star News}}</ref>
